auth.welcomeSubtitle: Manage loyalty points, offers and members.
auth.invalidCredentials: The email or password is incorrect.
auth.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
auth.passwordChanged: Password changed. Please sign in again.
auth.passwordTooShort: The new password must be at least 12 characters.
auth.footerNote: Authorised access only. All activity is recorded.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: An overview of loyalty activity.

charts.tierDistributionHint: Distribution across the current page of wallets
charts.offersByMerchantHint: Top merchants by number of offers
charts.noChartData: Not enough data to chart yet.

dashboard.limitedView: Some sections are hidden because your role does not include the permissions to read them.

wallets.title: Wallets
wallets.subtitle: Member point balances and ranks.
wallets.emptyHint: Wallets are created automatically when a member first earns points.
wallets.notFound: This member has no loyalty wallet yet.
wallets.apiNote: The loyalty service stores the member's external user ID, phone number, points and tier.

transactions.title: Point Transactions
transactions.subtitle: Every point movement on a member's wallet.
transactions.selectUserHint: Transactions are read per member. Enter a user ID to begin.
transactions.selectUserPrompt: Enter a user ID to view their transactions.
transactions.emptyHint: Try changing the type filter, or check the user ID.

tiers.title: Membership Tiers
tiers.subtitle: The rank ladder members progress through.
tiers.levelHint: Higher levels rank above lower ones.
tiers.emptyHint: Create a tier to start the rank ladder.
tiers.noDeleteNote: Tiers cannot be deleted — deactivate one instead to retire it.
tiers.levelTaken: Another tier already uses this level.

categories.title: Categories
categories.subtitle: How merchants are grouped for members.
categories.emptyHint: Try changing your filters or create a new category.
categories.noDeleteNote: Categories cannot be deleted — deactivate one instead.
categories.iconHint: Shown beside the category name for members.

merchants.title: Merchants
merchants.subtitle: Partners whose offers members can redeem.
merchants.emptyHint: Try changing your filters or create a new merchant.
merchants.noDeleteNote: Merchants cannot be deleted — deactivate one instead.
merchants.logoHint: Shown to members wherever this merchant appears.
merchants.backgroundHint: The wide image behind this merchant's header.
merchants.iconHint: A small square mark, used where the full logo will not fit.
merchants.citiesHint: The cities this merchant operates in. Branches may only open in these cities.
merchants.cityInUse: A city that still has branches cannot be removed.
merchants.createdNowBranches: Merchant created. You can now add its branches.

branches.title: Branches
branches.subtitle: Physical locations belonging to a merchant.
branches.emptyHint: Try changing your filters or create a new branch.
branches.deleteConfirmBody: Are you sure you want to delete the branch “{name}”? This cannot be undone.
branches.cityNote: One of this merchant's cities. Branches in the same city share one record.
branches.onlyMerchantCities: Only this merchant's cities can be selected.
branches.noMerchantCities: This merchant has no cities yet. Add one to the merchant first.
branches.backgroundHint: The wide image behind this branch's header.
branches.iconHint: A small square mark, used where the full image will not fit.

cities.title: Cities
cities.subtitle: Cities served by a merchant's branches.
cities.emptyHint: Create a city so offers can be restricted to it.
cities.deleteConfirmBody: Are you sure you want to delete “{name}”? This cannot be undone.
cities.stillReferenced: This city is still used by offers or members and cannot be deleted.
cities.sharedNote: One city for the whole platform. Every merchant with a branch here uses this same record.

branchRules.title: Branch Offer Rules
branchRules.subtitle: What an offer costs and is worth at each branch.
branchRules.requiredPointsHint: What activating at this branch costs. Overrides the offer's own points.
branchRules.voucherValidityHint: How long a voucher stays valid after activation. Separate from the offer's own dates.
branchRules.windowHint: When the offer can be activated at this branch. Leave empty for no limit.
branchRules.emptyHint: Add a rule to give a branch its own points and discount for an offer.
branchRules.deleteConfirmBody: The branch will fall back to the offer's own points and discount. Vouchers already issued keep their terms. Continue?
branchRules.completedUsersHint: Members who have used a voucher for this offer at this branch, counted once each. Branch figures are separate statistics and do not add up to the offer's own total.
branchRules.duplicateError: This offer already has a rule for that branch.
branchRules.snapshotNote: Changing a rule never alters a voucher already issued under it — each voucher keeps the terms it was activated with.
branchRules.fallbackNote: A branch with no rule uses the offer's own required points and discount.

offers.title: Offers
offers.subtitle: What members can redeem their points for.
offers.validDaysHint: How long a voucher stays valid after it is issued.
offers.minimumSpendingHint: Leave empty for no spending requirement.
offers.emptyHint: Try changing your filters or create a new offer.
offers.noDeleteNote: Offers cannot be deleted — deactivate one instead so existing vouchers stay valid.
offers.rankNote: Members at this rank or above can redeem the offer.
offers.cityHint: Leave as “All cities” for a global offer. Choosing a city limits the offer to members in it.
offers.branchRulesHint: Points, discount and voucher validity per branch.
offers.noBranchRules: No branch rules yet — every branch uses the offer's own points and discount.
offers.showQrCodeOn: Vouchers carry a scannable QR code.
offers.showQrCodeOff: No QR code is generated. The voucher code must be typed in at the counter.
offers.showQrCodeChangeNote: This applies to vouchers issued from now on. Vouchers members already hold are unchanged.
offers.descriptionHint: Shown to customers on the offer details view.
offers.expiresAtHint: Leave empty for an offer that never expires.
offers.tiersHint: Leave every tier unselected to allow all of them.
offers.allBranchesHint: The offer applies to every branch of this merchant.
offers.selectMerchantFirst: Choose a merchant to list its branches.
offers.noMerchantBranches: This merchant has no branches yet.
offers.previewHint: A summary of what will be saved.
offers.completedUsersHint: Members who have used a voucher for this offer, counted once each.

vouchers.title: Vouchers
vouchers.subtitle: Validate and consume vouchers presented at a merchant.
vouchers.voucherCodePlaceholder: Enter or scan the voucher code
vouchers.orderIdHint: Optional reference from your point-of-sale system.
vouchers.validateHint: A read-only check. It does not consume the voucher.
vouchers.merchantContextHint: Required: an administrator has no merchant of their own.
vouchers.consumeConfirmBody: This marks the voucher as used and cannot be undone. Continue?
vouchers.memberVouchersHint: Vouchers are listed per member. Enter a user ID to view theirs.
vouchers.emptyHint: Try changing the status filter, or check the user ID.
vouchers.noListNote: The API exposes vouchers per member rather than as one global list, so this page reads them by user ID.
vouchers.cancelConfirmBody: This stops the voucher being redeemed. Points are NOT refunded. Continue?
vouchers.cancelNoRefundNote: Cancelling does not refund the member's points.
vouchers.snapshotNote: Each voucher keeps the discount and points it was activated with, even if the branch rule changes afterwards.
vouchers.branchHint: Where the voucher is being presented. Required for a voucher issued against a branch.
vouchers.noQrCode: No QR code for this offer

statistics.title: Activation Statistics
statistics.subtitle: Activation and redemption totals across the system.
statistics.branchPerformanceHint: Covers vouchers issued for a specific branch.
statistics.emptyBranchesHint: Figures appear once offers are activated at a branch.

subscriptions.title: Subscription Processing
subscriptions.subtitle: Award loyalty points for a subscription the billing system has taken.
subscriptions.isMobileAppHint: Whether the subscription was taken in the mobile app.
subscriptions.userIdHint: The member's external user ID, as a GUID.
subscriptions.priceHint: Points are calculated from this amount by the server.
subscriptions.optionalSectionHint: Recorded on the transaction for traceability. None of these affect the points awarded.
subscriptions.idempotencyWarning: This endpoint is not idempotent. Submitting the same subscription again may award points again.
subscriptions.formulaNoteGeneric: The server calculates the award from the price using the global point settings.
subscriptions.zeroPointsBody: The price was below one full point threshold, so the balance is unchanged. This is not an error.

validation.userIdInvalid: User ID must be a valid GUID.

settings.title: Point Settings
settings.subtitle: The global rule that turns spending into points.
settings.pointThresholdHint: The amount of spending, in IQD, that earns one bucket of points.
settings.pointsPerThresholdHint: How many points each completed bucket awards.
settings.defaultsNote: When no configuration has been saved, the server uses 50 IQD for 1 point.
settings.appliesNote: This formula is what subscription processing uses to award points.
settings.amountIqdHint: The amount of spending, in IQD, that earns the points below.
settings.pointsHint: How many points that amount of spending awards.

packages.title: Packages
packages.subtitle: Subscription packages known to the loyalty system.
packages.externalPackageIdHint: The identifier the billing system uses, e.g. PKG-300.
packages.emptyHint: Create a package to record one from the billing system.
packages.legacyNote: Packages are recorded for reference. Subscription processing awards points from the price and the global point settings, not from a package.

packageRules.title: Package Rules
packageRules.subtitle: Legacy fixed-point rules attached to a package.
packageRules.emptyHint: Create a rule to attach fixed points to a package.
packageRules.legacyWarning: Subscription processing no longer reads these rules — points come from the price and the global point settings. These endpoints remain available, so the screen is kept for administration.

admins.title: Admin Users
admins.subtitle: People who administer the loyalty system.
admins.passwordResetHint: Leave empty to keep the current password. Setting one signs the administrator out everywhere.
admins.emptyHint: Try changing your filters or create a new administrator.
admins.deactivateConfirmBody: Are you sure you want to deactivate {name}? They will no longer be able to sign in.
admins.rolesReplaceNote: The selected roles replace the administrator's current set.
admins.noRolesWarning: An administrator with no roles can sign in but cannot do anything.

roles.title: Roles
roles.subtitle: Named sets of permissions granted to administrators.
roles.emptyHint: Create a role to group permissions together.
roles.deleteConfirmBody: Are you sure you want to delete the role “{name}”? This cannot be undone.
roles.permissionsReplaceNote: The selected permissions replace the role's current set.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.subtitle: Every capability the system can grant.
permissions.emptyHint: The permission catalogue is declared by the backend.
permissions.readOnlyNote: This catalogue is declared in the backend and cannot be edited here. Assign permissions to a role instead.

clients.title: API Clients
clients.subtitle: Server-to-server credentials used by external systems.
clients.merchantHint: Bind a client to a merchant so it can act on that merchant's vouchers.
clients.revokeConfirmBody: This stops the credential working immediately. The client record is kept. Continue?
clients.deleteConfirmBody: Are you sure you want to delete “{name}”? This cannot be undone.
clients.emptyHint: Create a client so an external system can call the API.
clients.secretBody: This is the only time the key is shown. It is not stored and cannot be retrieved again. If it is lost you must issue a new client.
clients.contactEmailHint: Contact address for this client's owner.

states.emptyBody: There is no data for the current filters.
states.forbiddenBody: Your role does not include the permission needed to view this.
states.notFoundBody: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.
states.offlineBody: Check that the API is running and reachable, then try again.

errors.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to perform this action.
errors.notFound: The requested item was not found.
errors.conflict: This conflicts with the current state of the data.
errors.server: The server could not complete the request.

codes.PACKAGE_NOT_FOUND: That package is not registered in the loyalty system.
codes.PACKAGE_RULE_NOT_FOUND: That package has no active point rule.
codes.USER_WALLET_NOT_FOUND: This member has no loyalty wallet.
codes.RANK_NOT_ELIGIBLE: The member's rank is below the offer's requirement.
codes.INSUFFICIENT_POINTS: The member does not have enough points.
codes.MINIMUM_SPENDING_NOT_MET: The member has not met the offer's minimum spending.
codes.MERCHANT_NOT_AUTHORIZED: You are not authorised to act for that merchant.
codes.MERCHANT_BRANCH_ALREADY_EXISTS: A branch with these details already exists.
codes.MEMBERSHIP_TIER_NOT_FOUND: That membership tier was not found.
codes.VOUCHER_ALREADY_USED: That voucher has already been used.
codes.CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT: Someone else changed this at the same time. Please retry.
codes.OFFER_CITY_RESTRICTION: This offer is not available in your city.
codes.BRANCH_RULE_NOT_FOUND: This offer is not configured for the selected branch.
codes.BRANCH_RULE_INACTIVE: This offer is not currently available at the selected branch.
codes.BRANCH_MERCHANT_MISMATCH: The selected branch does not belong to this offer's merchant.
codes.BRANCH_RULE_ALREADY_EXISTS: This offer already has a rule for the selected branch.
codes.CITY_ALREADY_EXISTS: A city with this name already exists for this branch.
codes.VOUCHER_BRANCH_MISMATCH: This voucher was issued for a different branch.
codes.ATTACHMENT_TOO_LARGE: This file is larger than the maximum allowed size.
codes.ATTACHMENT_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: This file type is not supported.
codes.ATTACHMENT_CONTENT_MISSING: The stored file could not be read.
codes.SUBSCRIPTION_ALREADY_PROCESSED: This subscription has already been awarded points.

validation.percentageRange: Enter a percentage greater than 0 and up to 100.
validation.amountPositive: Enter an amount greater than zero.

upload.tooLarge: This file is larger than the maximum allowed size.
upload.wrongType: This file type is not supported.

map.pickHint: Click the map to place the pin, or drag it. Ctrl+scroll to zoom.
map.locateUnsupported: This browser cannot share a location.
